At the attainable fill every book loses: RI-04's control and its 21 forks, RI-05 whole, and RI-05's four rules forked one at a time onto RI-04's control. What is the one binding stage now, and what is the reversible half?

recommendation.label: INFERENCE
recommendation.text: RULED: option A. The binding stage for both contracts is the edge at the attainable fill: no entry in either contract is positive, whole or forked, and every exit fork of a negative entry is negative. Work only there: RI-05's rules are forked one at a time onto the control, a candidate must be positive as well as beat the control, RI-05 is judged only on days after its tuning tape, and no real SOL buys a fill bit until a fork is positive at the first mark. RI-04's contract and verdict stand. Capping the count is a rule-7 item for the operator, not the binding stage.
